description: ArduPilot SITL period (3 ms). ArduCopter runs its rate, attitude and position controllers in every main loop (FAST_TASK in ArduCopter/Copter.cpp); in SITL the main loop runs once per sensor frame, 3 ms with the Hakoniwa physics step (333 Hz). Every Hakoniwa control cycle is therefore 3 ms, unlike PX4 (attitude 6 ms, outer loops 21 ms). Vehicle independent. Pass to create-pid-tuning-profile.bash --timing-profile.
